Maya, can you commit to completing that scope-mapped reconciliation on an expedited basis? Jordan, please ensure the revised interview plan language accounts for the separate-counsel constraint.

If all of that is acceptable, I will not sign the submission until the scoped repayment figure is confirmed and the interview plan is revised. Do we have agreement on this approach?
